parameters.name: ReserveQueryString
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to preserve the query string. Valid values:

- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0.

parameters.name: StatusCode
parameters.description:
The response status code used by the node when responding to the client with the redirect address. Valid values:

- 301
- 302
- 303
- 307
- 308.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The redirect type. Valid values:

- static: Static pattern.
- dynamic: Dynamic pattern.
